# `Q-2-29` — Indented Footnote Content Not Supported

> Pandoc-style indented footnote content does not work in Quarto
> markdown; use the `::: ^ref … :::` div syntax instead.

## What this means

Pandoc supports a footnote-definition form where the content
sits as an indented block beneath the reference:

```markdown
Some text[^1].

[^1]:
    The footnote content, indented.
```

Quarto markdown does not parse that form. Instead, it represents
footnote bodies as fenced divs labelled with the reference:

```markdown
Some text[^1].

::: ^1
The footnote content.
:::
```

## Why this happens

Most often the markdown was copied from a Pandoc document, or
written by someone familiar with Pandoc but new to Quarto.

## How to fix

Convert the indented body to the div form. The reference inside
the div (`^1` in the example) must match the reference in the
text.

## Example

```markdown
Some text[^1].

[^1]:
    Body.
```
